items.title: Karur Vysya Bank net profit surges 45% to Rs 756 crore in Q1, asset quality sees slight slip
items.description: Karur Vysya Bank announced a significant 45% rise in first quarter net profit.  This increase brought their earnings to ₹756 crore compared to the previous year.  The bank's pre-provision operating profit also saw a substantial 36% jump.  Net interest income grew by 32%, boosting overall financial performance.  However, the bank's gross non-performing assets experienced a slight increase.
